title: Microsoft outage disrupts global tech services

slides.headline: Microsoft outage disrupts global tech services
slides.subtitle: Outlook and Teams services are currently recovering

slides.explanation: The outage was widespread enough to impact essential public services including hospitals, GP surgeries, schools, and police forces across the UK.

slides.headline: The underlying cause has been addressed
slides.explanation: Microsoft says they have fixed the core issue that took down their services, though they remain deeply sorry for the global disruption caused to users.
Seven independent news outlets, including the BBC and TechCrunch, have verified the details of this outage and Microsoft's response.

slides.subtitle: Read the full story on Headlinne.

caption:
A major Microsoft outage briefly took down key communication tools like Outlook and Teams, leaving users worldwide unable to

access their accounts.

The disruption was significant enough to affect critical public infrastructure, including schools and medical services.

Microsoft has since confirmed that the underlying issue is resolved and services are coming back online. They have issued an apology for the inconvenience caused by the downtime.

story.summary: Tech firm says it is ‘deeply sorry’ for disruption that took services down and has now addressed the underlying issue What caused the outage and when will it be fixed?
